description: This file defines a React component and auxiliary functions for a layout specific to a shop segment. It includes static parameters for pre-rendering certain shop IDs, and renders a contextual header based on route parameters. It is part of a Next.js application, managing shop-specific layouts with static generation.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: Returns a list of known shop IDs for static pre-rendering.

methods.name: ShopSegmentLayout
methods.description: Main React component for rendering shop-specific layout, including a contextual header with shop ID.
